name: SSHI_FullBridge_RCFilter
rationale: The previous best design SSHI_FullBridge_Zener was very close, only failing on S3 ripple (0.061V vs 0.05V) and S5 settling (0.022V vs 0.02V). To reduce these high-frequency ripple components and smooth the settling behavior without the significant startup penalty seen with an LC filter (as in SSHI_FullBridge_LCFilter), I am introducing a small series resistance (R1) between the rectifier output and the storage capacitor C1. This creates an RC low-pass filter that will damp the charging spikes from the SSHI pulses. Since the load current is very low (uA range), the voltage drop across a small R1 will be negligible, preserving the average output voltage.
